description: Prespecified sensitivity analysis. The original reduced models, physical ports, and propagation trajectories are retained. All attribution paths and exact/linear error budgets use the same 512-square propagation reference. No thresholds or coefficients are fitted to favorable outcomes.
time_norm: Equal weights on stored samples. Zero is included. Later disjoint windows exclude their left endpoint. Absolute time since source initialization is used in every derivative.
path_semantics: rom fixes H_r; fine fixes H_f; symmetric fixes (H_r+H_f)/2. Each path is an exact algebraic partition with a compensating coupling term. The alternative interventions are reference-dependent diagnostics, not modified reduced solvers or unique physical percentages.
prediction_scope: Gram analyses are reference-assisted local approximations evaluated without fitted parameters. Full q uses the reference response. Exact identities are verification and attribution, not independent forecasts. No reference-free or unseen-source prediction is claimed.
